mnemonic: The hand 扌 pulls and the whole thing comes away in it, root and all. He walked out of the group the same way and the gap stayed: ぬける.
sentence: 彼はグループから抜けました。

mnemonic: The sun 日 has gone out of the room and there is nothing left in it but sound 音. You find the switch by feel: くらい.
notes: Same reading as くらい, about or approximately, which is written in kana. If it is doing a job on a number it is that one. This one is a room you cannot see across.
sentence: 部屋が暗いです。

mnemonic: Straight down through the nose 自 to the heart 心 and back out again, and the doctor wants a big one held for four seconds: いき.
notes: The same 息 as 息子, son, where a breath of your own walks off and turns into a person.
sentence: 大きく息を吸ってください。

mnemonic: 駄 worthless and 目 a point on the board. In go it is a square that does nobody any good, and it kept that meaning when it left the game: だめ.
notes: Shares 駄 with 無駄, wasteful. だめ is a verdict on a thing or a person, むだ is effort that went nowhere.
sentence: 彼は駄目な男だ。

mnemonic: One spot of fire 灬 and nothing else, and the teacher puts a row of them down the margin. His came to about ten out of forty: てん.
sentence: 昨日のテストの点は良くなかったです。
sentence_meaning: My score on yesterday's test wasn't good.

mnemonic: You put your own 力 power and your 口 mouth in with the ones already going 参, and by Sunday you are running a marathon you never trained for: さんか.
sentence: 明日は市民マラソンに参加します。
sentence_meaning: I'll participate in the citizens' marathon tomorrow.

mnemonic: Yesterday the mountain was a rumour somewhere behind the haze. This morning you can count the trees along the ridge from the kitchen: はっきり.
sentence: 今日は山がはっきり見える。
sentence_meaning: You can see the mountains clearly today.

mnemonic: A hand 扌 puts a seedling 苗 of the thing down on the paper and grows it from there. It came out as a panda: かく.
notes: Same reading as 書く, to write, and the same word as 描く えがく. 書く puts down words and 描く puts down a picture. かく for the everyday drawing, えがく when it is a proper depiction.
sentence: パンダの絵を描きました。

meaning: to depict, to describe, to draw
mnemonic: The same hand 扌 and the same seedling 苗, taken slowly this time. He can put a person on paper so that you know who it is: えがく.
notes: The same 描く as かく, to draw. えがく is the heavier of the two, a proper depiction, and it stretches to describing something in words as well.
sentence: 彼は人物を描くのがうまいな。
sentence_meaning: He is good at drawing people.

mnemonic: He looks 見 straight at it and carries on as though there were nothing 無 there at all. The opinion was said out loud and went nowhere: むし.
sentence: 彼の意見は無視されたよ。

mnemonic: Thirty young shoots 生 walking 彳 in through the same door at the same time every morning, and somebody has to count them: せいと.
sentence: このクラスの生徒は30人です。
sentence_meaning: There are 30 students in this class.

mnemonic: He can tell you about every sheep 羊 in the field one at a time 言, and you had asked for the short version: くわしい.
sentence: もっと詳しく説明してください。

mnemonic: An insect 虫 puts one horn 角 out and barely makes contact, and the little sign under the painting says not to: さわる.
sentence: この絵に触らないでください。
sentence_meaning: Please do not touch this picture.

mnemonic: He draws a line under everything as far as today and says the person who did all that is not the one standing here now: これまで.
sentence: これまでの私とは違うんです。
sentence_meaning: I am different from the old me.

mnemonic: The line goes down the middle 半 and the knife 刀 follows it, and you get one side of the tomato and I get the other: はんぶん.
sentence: トマトを半分に切ってください。
sentence_meaning: Please cut the tomato in half.

mnemonic: The ground goes and the building stays up, a hand 寸 holding on to the one thing not moving. Everything inside it fell over and it did not: たえる.
sentence: このビルは大地震に耐えられるでしょうか。
sentence_meaning: Would this building be able to withstand a large earthquake?

mnemonic: Where you happen to be standing 立 on the ground 土, and what the thing looks like from there. She has not worked out where she is standing yet: たちば.
sentence: 彼女は自分の立場を分かっていない。

mnemonic: A lump off the cliff lying exactly where it landed 石, and your foot finds it in the dark. Down you go: いし.
sentence: 私は石につまづいた。

mnemonic: Two hands 扌 pushing up close and pressing together, which is the only thing either of these characters ever does. Said loudly, every morning: あいさつ.
sentence: いつも元気に挨拶しています。

mnemonic: Two of you with an eye 目 on the same problem, and the talk 談 running long enough to warm the room. There is something I want to ask you about: そうだん.
sentence: 相談したいことがあります。
sentence_meaning: I'd like to get your advice on something.

mnemonic: One hand down and one up 受 and the thing passes between them, and then it goes in 入 and stays in. He took the other man's view and kept it: うけいれる.
sentence: 私は彼の意見を受け入れました。

mnemonic: Feathers 羽 going over the same movement until it finally comes out smooth 練, an hour a day, and next door hears every minute: れんしゅう.
sentence: 娘は今、バイオリンを練習しています。
sentence_meaning: My daughter is practicing the violin now.

mnemonic: A packhorse 駄 loaded up and walked all that way for nothing 無. Whatever was in the bags, nobody wanted any of it: むだ.
notes: Shares 駄 with 駄目, no good. むだ is the effort wasted, だめ is the verdict.
sentence: 無駄な買い物はしません。

mnemonic: Both arms 扌 wrapped 包 right round it and his chin resting on the top, and he still has three floors to go: かかえる.
notes: Same 抱 as 抱く だく. 抱える is a load in your arms, 抱く is somebody held close.
sentence: 彼は大きな荷物を抱えているわ。
sentence_meaning: He is carrying some large luggage.

mnemonic: Everything set out on the altar 示 where the whole room can see it. She never said she was pleased, she let it show: しめす.
sentence: 彼女は良い反応を示したわ。

mnemonic: He carried the thing through 成 to the end of itself, and the work 工 and the power 力 in it finally came out where people could see. Twenty years at one company: せいこう.
sentence: 田中さんは仕事で成功しました。

meaning: to hug, to hold in one's arms
mnemonic: The same wrapped 包 arms 扌, except what is in them this time is warm and would rather be somewhere else. Grandma has the cat: だく.
notes: Same 抱 as 抱える かかえる, to carry in your arms. That one is a load, this one is a person or an animal.
sentence: 祖母がうちの猫を抱いているわよ。

mnemonic: It goes in the mouth 口 and for a second you have not 未 made up your mind, and then you have. This one needed salt: あじ.
notes: 興味 きょうみ borrows the same 味. An interest in something is a taste for it.
sentence: この料理は味が薄い。

mnemonic: Power 力 out in the field 田 and whatever the heart 忄 was born 生 with, put together for a form that only wants one box ticked: だんせい.
sentence: 彼は素敵な男性です。

mnemonic: A mouth 口 saying not 不, and saying it firmly enough to settle 定 the matter. His friend put an idea up and he took it straight back down: ひてい.
sentence: 彼、友達の意見を否定した。
sentence_meaning: He disagreed with his friend's opinion.

mnemonic: You watch the thing arrive 至 at their end, knowing you sent it, and you mention it as though you had barely been involved. I will be in touch: いたす.
notes: The humble form of する. Used about what you do yourself and never about anybody else, which is the whole point of it.
sentence: 私からご連絡致します。
sentence_meaning: I'll get in touch with you.

mnemonic: What you can actually see 見 in front of you, standing 在 on the ground, this minute. Thirty degrees, whatever it was yesterday: げんざい.
sentence: 現在の気温は30度です。

mnemonic: An army 軍 of small lights 光 all going at once, and the whole of it is happening in her eyes: かがやく.
sentence: 彼女の瞳は喜びで輝いていますね。
sentence_meaning: Her eyes are shining with delight.

mnemonic: The four dots of fire 灬 are underneath you now and have been since yesterday. Thermometer, bed, no arguing about it: ねつ.
sentence: 昨日から熱があります。
sentence_meaning: I have a fever since yesterday.

mnemonic: A woman 女 steps up onto the platform 台 and everything after that runs downhill from it. The trip was good for the first three days: はじめ.
sentence: 私たちの旅は始めはよかったんだ。
sentence_meaning: The start of our trip was good.

mnemonic: A cliff face 厳 with nothing to hold on to and no allowance made for how tired you are. Kimura-sensei, some days: きびしい.
sentence: 木村先生は時々厳しいです。

mnemonic: A character Japan made for itself, a wrapper with something shut inside it and getting out anyway. Somebody two doors down is cooking: におい.
sentence: いい匂いがする。

mnemonic: A mat spread out under the shelter 广 with nobody's coat on it. You ask anyway, because the alternative is standing: せき.
sentence: この席、空いてますか。

mnemonic: The stall 売 goes up, the thing goes out on it, and by the end of the day it belongs to somebody else. He put the house out there: うる.
sentence: 彼は家を売った。

meaning: to live, to make a living
mnemonic: The sun 日 goes down under the heap of the day 暮, then comes up and does it again, and that is what a life is actually made of: くらす.
sentence: ずっと日本で暮らしたいと思っています。
sentence_meaning: I think I would like to live in Japan all the time.

mnemonic: You take the knife 刂 to the grain 禾 because that is what the pair of them are for 用. The library is there and he is in it every week: りよう.
sentence: 私はよく図書館を利用します。

mnemonic: He is halfway through washing a cup and a thing from twenty years ago arrives in his head, unasked and whole. Nothing brought it on: ふと.
sentence: ふと昔の事を思い出したんだ。

mnemonic: The thread 糸 run end to end 経, and the horse 馬 gone over hoof by hoof 験. Do the lot of it while you are young and then you know: けいけん.
sentence: 若い時に色々経験しておきます。
sentence_meaning: I will experience a lot when I am young.

mnemonic: Twelve months and not one of them left the room the way it found it. One thing swapped out for another 化, then another, then another: へんか.
sentence: 今年は変化の多い年でした。
sentence_meaning: There was a lot of change this year.

mnemonic: The king's 王 child 子, and there is nothing else on his CV. The country is fond of him anyway: おうじ.
sentence: その王子は国民に愛されている。
sentence_meaning: That prince is loved by the people.

mnemonic: Filled 満 right up to the top, and a foot 足 that has walked far enough to stop. He looked at the result and wanted nothing more than that: まんぞく.
sentence: 彼は結果に満足したようです。
sentence_meaning: He seems to be satisfied with the result.

mnemonic: The drum keeps going and he keeps going with it, straight up the mountain path without once stopping to look at the view: どんどん.
sentence: 彼は山道をどんどん進んで行ったの。
sentence_meaning: He made steady progress along the mountain path.

mnemonic: Both halves are the same picture, somebody kneeling 卩 under a roof 𠆢 while it is handed down to them. She heard it and did not do it: めいれい.
sentence: 彼女は命令に従わなかった。

mnemonic: The lamp 主 on its stand in the middle of the room, everything else arranged round where the light falls. Her job is mostly the customers: おも.
sentence: 彼女の主な仕事は接客だよ。
sentence_meaning: Her main job is customer service.

mnemonic: A big 大 sheep 羊 and what the mouth 口 makes of it, which here is a second slice before the first one is finished: おいしい.
sentence: このケーキは美味しいね。
